notes_for_editor: Only the Land Information Ontario tower-layer record. The layer has no height, build date, purpose, power or status for this point. Two web searches returned nothing relevant, and a guessed firelookout.ca slug returned a 404, so there is no second source. The second layer entry, SF-56 (location 'Moses Twp.', about 4.2 km north-west by straight-line distance from the two coordinates), may be a separate tower or a duplicate; check before merging or hiding either. The story gives Ontario only because the brief has no local_unit or county. The brief's record matches the layer point, so no corrections.
